text:
Type: cantilever bentwood leather lounge armchair
Use: relaxing, reading; living room, study, reading corner
Style: mid-century modern, Scandinavian, contemporary
Materials: layer-glued bent wood frame in a dark brown stain, cognac leather cushion with diamond stitching
Colors: warm cognac brown, dark brown wood
Shape: tall one-piece cushion quilted in a diamond pattern, curved bentwood arms flowing into a springy cantilever base, reclined seat, open sides, medium visual weight
Feel: warm, inviting, relaxed, classic
Goes with: walnut or dark wood, cream walls, wool rugs, brass lamps; mid-century or classic living rooms and studies

product.name: PONG
product.description: Highly durable full-grain leather which is soft and has a natural look and feel.
